title: Is a round Minecraft world possible?
summary: Jeija demonstrates a modified Minetest game with a spherical planet, using a grid transform to make a voxel world round. It includes the orbit math and download links for the spheretest build.
why: Pointed to in Minetest and spherical-voxel-world threads as a striking example of what the open-source engine can do.

quote.text: A minetest developer just recently published a sphere-shaped planet version of minetest
